title: Wochenplan
description: Weekly schedule of a Monteur. References Aufträge by id; embeds optional execution metadata (started/paused/finished) when available.

monteurName.description: Denormalized name copy for offline display in disposition-web-app. Source of truth: Monteur.name.

wechseldatum.description: Concrete calendar date for this weekday. Can be derived from kalenderwoche + jahr + tag; persisted by disposition for offline use.

auftragIds.description: Ordered list of Auftrag.id values planned for this day.

routeGeojson.description: Optional pre-computed route geometry. Only freitag-webapp produces this.

status.description: Execution status. Only disposition-web-app tracks this; freitag-webapp leaves it null.
